dependencies.bignumber.js: Removed: immutable ExactNumber values and native BigInt; arithmetic is outside the JSON codec API.

changes: Enforce JSON number, string and whitespace syntax with bounded input, number and nesting limits.
Preserve exact integers and decimals without importing an arithmetic library.
Check dangerous property names exactly and preserve null-prototype maps.
Keep serialization state local; quote replacement strings and detect cycles.
Support replacer arrays, boxed primitives, surrogate escaping and native bigint values.
